description: Company ALKS 34 trial research source and clinical-five scorecard; clinical grades only after exact trial evidence and rubric; not FDA probabilities
notes: Evidence coverage and design diagnostic are documentation scores, not clinical predictions.
For all 34 exact NCTs, only source-supported clinical grades are numeric. Missing clinical factors remain null.
The full 5/5 research composite is computed by the existing clinical-five library only when all five scores are source supported and stage verified.
Historical outcomes must not be treated as prospective predictions.
All 34 records have primary-purpose disposition; safety-primary studies are not awarded arbitrary efficacy ratings.
Ongoing studies can have five prior-evidence research factors scored, which are not published Phase 3 efficacy results.
A full clinical five-factor score requires five individual exact-stage accepted reviews, not simply five available registry fields.

Primary outcomes for safety-only studies are generally descriptive nonbinary safety counts; full five-factor clinical efficacy composite is not applicable without actual efficacy endpoint measurements.
Original source reviews can be expanded as new source data become available, preserving NCT identities.
